claim: Miao and Ungar find calibration and verbalized-confidence signals are linearly encoded but orthogonal across three open-weight models and four datasets, and that joint reasoning plus verbalization worsens miscalibration (Reasoning Contamination Effect); a two-stage steering pipeline improves calibration.
stance_target: L2: probe-vs-verbal disconnect with causal steering exists outside code (NARROW overlap)
quoted_support: calibration and verbalized confidence signals are encoded linearly but are orthogonal to one another — a finding consistent across three open-weight models and four datasets.
